## Checklist

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/winksen/Crispy-Potato/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the rules and the full review checklist.

- [ ] `cargo validate` passes (CI runs it too)
- [ ] Every claim a reader could dispute has a source that says what the text says
- [ ] Dates, designers, licenses and links match Wikidata and the project's own site
- [ ] The tone is neutral, with no marketing language
- [ ] Fit ratings follow the rubric, and `possible` and `poor` have notes
- [ ] No collected number (stars, downloads, survey shares) is written into content
- [ ] The text is in my own words; any AI help was checked against the sources and is described below
- [ ] For code: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test` and `cargo deny check` pass
